subject: literacy
concept: Matching letters to their most common sounds (grapheme-phoneme correspondence) for single consonants and short vowels
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading explicit phonics sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student matches physical letter tiles to objects that start with that letter's sound
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the letter that matches a spoken sound
exercise.abstract: Student states the sound a shown letter makes

misconception_flags: says the letter name instead of its sound

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
